mission.title: SYPHONED POWER
mission.description: One player must drain the enemy's resources and power.
mission.full_text:
Asymmetric Primary Mission SYPHONED POWER One player must drain the enemy's resources and power.
OBJECTIVES: Siphon power from enemy installations.
ATTACKER OBJECTIVE: Siphon power from all 3 enemy installations.
DEFENDER OBJECTIVE: Protect the power installations.
TIMING: The game ends when all power is siphoned or at the end of battle round 5.
SCORING: - Attacker: 1 VP per installation siphoned - Defender: 1 VP per installation protected
Max VP: 5

mission.title: UNEVEN GROUND
mission.description: One player must control the high ground and difficult terrain.
mission.full_text:
Asymmetric Primary Mission UNEVEN GROUND One player must control the high ground and difficult terrain.
OBJECTIVES: Control the elevated terrain positions.
ATTACKER OBJECTIVE: Control at least 2 elevated positions.
DEFENDER OBJECTIVE: Prevent the enemy from controlling the high ground.
TIMING: The game ends at the end of battle round 5.
SCORING: 1 VP per battle round for each elevated position controlled.
Max VP: 5

mission.title: DENIED RESOURCES
mission.description: One player must deny the enemy access to vital resources.
mission.full_text:
Asymmetric Primary Mission DENIED RESOURCES One player must deny the enemy access to vital resources.
OBJECTIVES: Destroy or deny access to resource markers.
ATTACKER OBJECTIVE: Destroy all 3 resource markers.
DEFENDER OBJECTIVE: Protect the resource markers.
TIMING: The game ends when all resources are denied or at the end of battle round 5.
SCORING: - Attacker: 1 VP per resource denied - Defender: 1 VP per resource protected
Max VP: 5

mission.title: ESTABLISH CONTROL
mission.description: One player must establish dominance over key strategic points.
mission.full_text:
Asymmetric Primary Mission ESTABLISH CONTROL One player must establish dominance over key strategic points.
OBJECTIVES: Establish control over strategic objectives.
ATTACKER OBJECTIVE: Control at least 3 strategic points.
DEFENDER OBJECTIVE: Prevent the enemy from establishing control.
TIMING: The game ends at the end of battle round 5.
SCORING: 1 VP per strategic point controlled at the end of each battle round.
Max VP: 5

mission.title: HOLD OUT
mission.description: One player must hold a position against overwhelming odds.
mission.full_text:
Asymmetric Primary Mission HOLD OUT One player must hold a position against overwhelming odds.
OBJECTIVES: Survive and hold the defensive position.
ATTACKER OBJECTIVE: Break through the defensive line.
DEFENDER OBJECTIVE: Hold the position for 5 battle rounds.
TIMING: The game ends at the end of battle round 5.
SCORING: - Defender: 1 VP per battle round held - Attacker: 1 VP for each enemy unit destroyed
Max VP: 5
